Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper and internet personality who rose to fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana.” Known for his unconventional rap flow, West Coast sound, and viral personality, Blueface quickly became one of the most talked-about artists in hip-hop. Over the years, he has expanded into streaming and social media, regularly attracting attention for his personal life, relationships, and entertaining livestream moments. His relationships with Jaidyn Alexis, Chrisean Rock, and Nevaeh have also become major topics of discussion online.

S*xyy Red, whose real name is Janae Nierah Wherry, is a rapper from St. Louis, Missouri, who became one of hip-hop’s biggest breakout stars in 2023. She gained widespread attention with her viral hit “Pound Town” before continuing her success with songs like “SkeeYee,” “Get It S*xy,” and “U My Everything” featuring Drake. Known for her bold personality, catchy music, and unfiltered social media presence, S*xyy Red has built a massive following and collaborated with major artists, including Drake, Nicki Minaj, and Chief Keef.

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a rapper, reality television star, and social media personality from Baltimore, Maryland. She first gained recognition through Blueface’s reality series Blue Girls Club before becoming a breakout star on the Zeus Network’s Baddies. Her outspoken personality, viral moments, and highly publicized relationship with Blueface helped her build a massive following. She also starred alongside Blueface in their reality series Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. 

Outside of reality television, Chrisean has pursued music with songs like “Vibe” and “Mr. Take Ya B*tch” featuring Lil Mabu. She also shares a son with Blueface, and their complicated relationship has remained a major topic across social media. In recent years, Chrisean has continued expanding her career through music, television, and boxing while remaining one of the most recognizable personalities in viral entertainment.
